label: Holders of the joint-absence power HAS_INTELLECT_1, from the common GOD_4 root (inference)
rule: A root that the common root does not ground is the common root
meaning: 0c27f65a gives one actual root n of G at w that directly grounds every other actual concretum and has HAS_INTELLECT_1. A holder y is an actual root (argument 1's conclusion), so it is an actual concretum; the reach clause gives y = n or a G-ground from n to y, and a root has no actual concrete ground. So y = n and y has intellect. Constructive.
